purpose: Map the v76 healthcare-cost navigation signal into permanent regressions in the SAME Stödassistenten learning system without inventing a separate app or truth layer.

mappings.product_miss: The current public product has dedicated dental-cost help and broad economy/health routing, but lacks a focused boundary between outpatient patient fees/frikort and prescription-medicine high-cost protection, including multilingual and basic-needs overlap handling.
mappings.fix_or_guardrail: Extend the existing quick-help/person intelligence rather than creating a healthcare-cost app. Reuse the existing dental route. For non-dental healthcare costs, distinguish outpatient visit versus prescription medicine with at most one route-changing question, preserve economic-assistance visibility when food/housing are at risk, and fail closed on professional/research contexts. Exact regional fees and medicine ceilings remain primary-source-verified, time/region-sensitive facts.
mappings.truth_boundary: Discovery language and feedback are never truth. Material patient-fee, frikort, medicine-benefit, high-cost amount, regional rule, deadline, dental-support and eligibility claims require current responsible primary-source verification. Outpatient care and prescription medicines are separate cost-protection paths and must not be collapsed into one universal frikort.
